remarks: Stunning Calabasas Estate on over 2 Acres, this beautifully maintained estate offers the perfect blend of luxury, privacy, and space. Set on over 2 acres of lush, landscaped grounds with a dog run for the dog lovers the property features 4 spacious bedrooms and 4 elegant bathrooms, ideal for both comfortable living and stylish entertaining. Step outside to a serene oasis with a sparkling pool, surrounded by mature trees and manicured gardens that create a truly tranquil setting. Whether you're hosting gatherings or enjoying quiet mornings, the outdoor space offers endless possibilities.
